reason: A DSH Web GUI layout plugin that provides sliders for adjusting the conversation area and user-bubble widths, with local settings persistence and reset-to-default support.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DSH Web GUI 中通过滑块调节对话区和用户气泡宽度，并支持保存设置与恢复默认值。
summaries.en: Adjusts the DSH Web GUI conversation area and user-bubble widths with sliders, local settings persistence, and a reset-to-default option.

capabilities: Adjusts chat content and user-bubble widths through UI sliders
Overrides page layout CSS variables and width rules
Reads and writes local plugin settings through a loopback bridge
